page_label: 说　明　书 4/17 页

paragraphs.notes: Continuation fragment at the top of the page; the paragraph it belongs to (numbered on the previous page, presumably [0036]) is not marked here, so no marker is recorded.

paragraphs.zh: 作为本发明优选的技术方案，步骤(2)中所述碱性物质为氢氧化钠、氢氧化钾、叔丁醇钠、叔丁醇钾、氢化钠、氢化钾中的任意一种。
paragraphs.en: As a preferred technical solution of the present invention, the alkaline substance in step (2) is any one of sodium hydroxide, potassium hydroxide, sodium tert-butoxide, potassium tert-butoxide, sodium hydride and potassium hydride.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述氢氧化钠使用时先制成氢氧化钠水溶液，氢氧化钠的质量浓度为30～96％，例如可以是30％、40％、50％、60％、70％、85％或96％。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the said sodium hydroxide is first made into an aqueous sodium hydroxide solution when used, and the mass concentration of sodium hydroxide is 30 to 96％, for example it may be 30％, 40％, 50％, 60％, 70％, 85％ or 96％.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述氢氧化钾使用时先制成氢氧化钠水溶液，氢氧化钾的质量浓度为30～96％，例如可以是30％、40％、50％、60％、70％、85％或96％。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the said potassium hydroxide is first made into an aqueous sodium hydroxide solution when used, and the mass concentration of potassium hydroxide is 30 to 96％, for example it may be 30％, 40％, 50％, 60％, 70％, 85％ or 96％.
paragraphs.notes: As printed, this paragraph says potassium hydroxide is made into an aqueous SODIUM hydroxide solution (氢氧化钠水溶液) while the concentration that follows is that of potassium hydroxide. This looks like a copy error from [0038] in the original, but it is transcribed verbatim and not corrected. Verified character-for-character against the text layer.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱性物质的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)，例如可以是1:1.2、1:1.3、1:1.4或1:1.5。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the molar ratio of the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate in step (2) to the alkaline substance is 1:(1.2 to 1.5), for example it may be 1:1.2, 1:1.3, 1:1.4 or 1:1.5.
paragraphs.notes: 苯甲酸盐 is the salt of the benzoic acid (benzoate); translated literally as benzoate without specifying the counter-ion, which the text does not give here.

paragraphs.zh: 作为本发明优选的技术方案，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)，例如可以是1:1.2、1:1.3、1:1.4或1:1.5。
paragraphs.en: As a preferred technical solution of the present invention, the molar ratio of the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate in step (2) to the alkali metal alkoxide is 1:(1.2 to 1.5), for example it may be 1:1.2, 1:1.3, 1:1.4 or 1:1.5.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中所述碱金属醇盐为醇和碱金属反应得到。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the alkali metal alkoxide in step (2) is obtained by reacting an alcohol with an alkali metal.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述碱金属为金属钠或金属钾。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the said alkali metal is sodium metal or potassium metal.

paragraphs.zh: 在本发明中，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应时，加料顺序为先将碱性物质与醇加入反应溶剂中，而后加入所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐。
paragraphs.en: In the present invention, when the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate in step (2) reacts with the alcohol in the presence of the alkaline substance, the order of addition is to first add the alkaline substance and the alcohol into the reaction solvent, and then add the said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.

paragraphs.zh: 在本发明中，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应时的加料顺序为先将碱金属醇盐放入溶剂中，再加入所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐。
paragraphs.en: In the present invention, the order of addition when the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate in step (2) reacts with the alkali metal alkoxide is to first put the alkali metal alkoxide into the solvent, and then add the said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明中，步骤(2)中加料顺序是不可改变的，若将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐先放入溶剂中，滴加碱性物质与醇的混合液或者滴加醇钠或醇钾进行反应，则苄醇杂质以及双接杂质会大幅增加。
paragraphs.en: In the present invention, the order of addition in step (2) cannot be changed; if the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate is first put into the solvent and the mixed liquid of the alkaline substance and the alcohol is added dropwise, or sodium alkoxide or potassium alkoxide is added dropwise, to carry out the reaction, then the benzyl alcohol impurity and the double-attachment impurity will increase greatly.
paragraphs.notes: 双接杂质 is translated literally as "double-attachment impurity"; the Chinese is a colloquial shop term and the page does not define which structure it means, so the intended reading is not stated here. 醇钠/醇钾 are literally sodium alkoxide / potassium alkoxide.

paragraphs.zh: 作为本发明优选的技术方案，步骤(2)中使用的溶剂为乙腈、DMF、DMSO或THF中的任意一种或至少两种的组合。
paragraphs.en: As a preferred technical solution of the present invention, the solvent used in step (2) is any one of acetonitrile, DMF, DMSO or THF, or a combination of at least two of them.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中相对于1mol的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐，所述溶剂的用量为700～3500mL，例如可以是700mL、1000mL、1500mL、2000mL、2500mL、3000mL或3500mL。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, in step (2), relative to 1mol of the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, the amount of the said solvent used is 700 to 3500mL, for example it may be 700mL, 1000mL, 1500mL, 2000mL, 2500mL, 3000mL or 3500mL.

paragraphs.zh: 作为本发明优选的技术方案，步骤(2)中所述反应的温度为-5～15℃，例如可以是-5℃、0℃、5℃、10℃或15℃。
paragraphs.en: As a preferred technical solution of the present invention, the temperature of the reaction in step (2) is -5 to 15℃, for example it may be -5℃, 0℃, 5℃, 10℃ or 15℃.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐分批加入步骤(2)的反应体系中，所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐的总加料时间为1～3h，例如可以是1h、1.5h、2h、2.5h或3h；
paragraphs.en: Preferably, in step (2) the said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate is added in batches into the reaction system of step (2), and the total addition time of the said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate is 1 to 3h, for example it may be 1h, 1.5h, 2h, 2.5h or 3h;
paragraphs.notes: Ends with a full-width semicolon (；) as printed, not a full stop.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中所述反应时间为3～6h，例如可以是3h、4h、5h或6h。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the reaction time in step (2) is 3 to 6h, for example it may be 3h, 4h, 5h or 6h.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中所述反应完成后经过酸化得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, after the reaction in step (2) is complete, the said 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid is obtained through acidification.
paragraphs.notes: 烷氧基 is the generic "alkoxy"; the specific alcohol is not fixed here. Note the product is the free acid (苯甲酸) whereas the starting material in the same step is the salt (苯甲酸盐).

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述酸化使用的酸为盐酸。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the acid used for the said acidification is hydrochloric acid.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述酸化后反应体系的pH值为2～3，例如可以是2、2.1、2.3、2.4、2.5、2.7或3。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the pH value of the reaction system after the said acidification is 2 to 3, for example it may be 2, 2.1, 2.3, 2.4, 2.5, 2.7 or 3.
paragraphs.notes: The enumerated list skips 2.2 and 2.6 as printed; transcribed exactly.
